brief: @buildthis.bisks.net a tool that scans someone's posts and finds failure modes in their thinking and assigns the size of the LLM in GB that has similar failure modes
note: downloads someone's whole post history (one repo CAR, no page cap) and greps for reversals, hedge fog, unearned certainty, whataboutism, doomcasting, and broken-record repeats, then tells you the GB and quantization of LLM that fails the same way. no model in the loop, just a heuristic with opinions.
